scope: reproduce and minimally repair intermittent two-Heavy PMG black masking; spawn positioning, debris and roster work excluded

reproducer.artifact: baseline HEAD 76a2d7d, rebuilt and run only in an isolated temporary directory
reproducer.policy: raider-proof, production movement/render path, no synthetic renderer bypass
examples: frame 71: P1 Raider absent while P2 remains visible and both final PMG page snapshots report 13 nonzero rows
frame 119: one full 220-pixel opaque silhouette interval is black
frame 255: P1 is reduced to a partial line while P2 remains intact
reproducer.overlap_interpretation: The controlled geometric overlap itself renders the correct union under normal P1 priority. It makes the failure conspicuous but is not the cause; the same clear-to-redraw DMA race can fire while the two objects are close or separated.

before_sequence: erase_enemy_member writes zero through all 14 rows of P1 and then P2 at writer PC 0x2D77
draw_enemy republishes both full bodies; body store PC 0x63AB
ANTIC PMG DMA may fetch between the full clear and the later redraw
root_cause.why_memory_snapshots_looked_correct: The final per-frame P1/P2 pages each contained 13 nonzero rows; corruption occurred at DMA fetch time while those pages temporarily contained zeros.

hypotheses.H2_old_new_ordering: CONFIRMED: full erase of both bodies precedes both simulations and both redraws
hypotheses.H3_wrong_pmg_base: REJECTED: slot selects page high 0x3D or 0x3E with explicit CLC
hypotheses.H4_pointer_index_overflow: REJECTED: GAMEPLAY_BOTTOM clipping and page-local Y keep all stores in range
hypotheses.H5_shared_scratch: REJECTED: exact host write provenance retains the selected slot/page
hypotheses.H6_gtia_priority: REJECTED: overlapping opaque union is correct with PRIOR=0 and equal COLPM1/COLPM2
hypotheses.H7_sprite_asset: REJECTED: the same 14-row asset renders correctly on safe frames
hypotheses.H8_double_render_lifecycle: REJECTED: master PAL trace admits one update_enemy invocation per active frame

contract: update and draw each active Raider immediately on its own PMG page
after the new body is published, clear only the single scanline which departed the old +/-1 footprint
retain full two-member erase only in ENEMY_REVIEW_HARNESS builds
fix.architectural_changes: none: no compositor, buffer, ownership map, PMG reassignment or gameplay change

pmg_memory_proof.native_note: Native final-page snapshots and the raster oracle show no cross-corruption; exact writer ownership is asserted by the host NMOS write hook.

tests.host_pmg_provenance: PASS: 6 geometries, 0 foreign-page writes, 0 full-page blank states
